title: Snake
rules: Avoid your tail. The clock keeps running during pauses. Your score waits for an opponent before the match result is decided.
manual:
# Controls
Use **arrow keys** or swipe to turn.

![Snake arena](assets/tutorial-scene.png)

## Scoring
Collect gold orbs to earn points.
description: Guide a growing snake across the arena and collect as many orbs as you can.
goal: Earn points by collecting orbs. Avoid your tail and, when wrapping is off, the walls.

tutorial.text: Use arrow keys or swipe to turn.
Collect the gold orbs before time runs out.
